extDescription.message: The sage holds the essential; all directions serve. BYOK Edge sidebar AI: page chat, agent actions, skills, translation, checks.

emptyChat.message: Ask a question about the current page. Add your AI provider and API key in Settings.

demoNotice.message: Demo mode — no provider configured, replies are simulated locally.

pageContextChip.message: Will send: body {body} chars · viewport {viewport} chars · selection {selection} chars

readPageNoAccess.message: No access to this tab: the panel wasn't opened via the toolbar icon, or this site isn't granted yet. Click "Grant access" to allow this site once (permanent), or click the toolbar icon to reopen the panel.

keyRememberHint.message: Stored in plain text in this browser's profile. Off = kept in memory until the browser closes.

demoModeHint.message: Simulate replies without an API key.

privacyHint.message: Page content is sent only to the provider you configure, and is never stored on any server of ours.

errorNoProvider.message: No provider configured. Using demo mode.

errorNoKey.message: No API key for this provider. Add it in Settings.

errorNeedOrigin.message: No permission to access {origin}. Grant access in the browser prompt.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check the Base URL and your connection.

agentMaxSteps.message: Reached the max of 10 action steps. Stopped. Describe the next step to continue.

toolInvalidRetry.message: (The model returned an incomplete action; asking it to retry)

riskHint.message: Every step is confirmed by default; use "Approve & auto-run" for task mode (critical actions like pay/submit/password still ask).

autoRunning.message: Task mode: running remaining steps automatically (critical actions like pay/submit/password still ask). Click Stop anytime.

translationNotice.message: Full-page translation in progress: do not scroll the page (scrolling shifts lazy-loaded content and misaligns translations) until it finishes.

skillsHint.message: Skills are professional instruction packs injected to the AI: active in every chat once installed; toggle them any time. Enabled skills consume a little context.

skillNone.message: No skills installed yet. Install from the store below or import JSON.

logsHint.message: Errors and action results are logged locally (no API keys, no conversation content). Useful for troubleshooting.

tasksHint.message: Let the AI check a page on a schedule (price, stock, changes…). Results pop a local system notification. Only your own model provider is called; nothing passes through any server.

taskPromptPlaceholder.message: e.g. check whether the price changed and report old vs new

menuTaskDesc.message: Check this page on a schedule, then notify

quickTaskSaved.message: Saved: the page will be checked on schedule and results will pop a system notification. Manage it under "Scheduled checks" in Settings.

aboutSlogan.message: The sage holds the essentials; all directions come to serve.

aboutIntro.message: Zhiyao Agent is a web AI assistant in the Edge sidebar: bring your own OpenAI-compatible API key to chat about the current page, let the AI operate web pages, translate a whole page in place, download media, and schedule page checks. Everything flows only between you and your own model provider — nothing passes through any server.

aboutFeatureChat.message: Chat about the current page (body / viewport / selection)

aboutFeatureAgent.message: Agent page operations: click, type, scroll and 17+ tools, step-by-step confirm plus task mode

aboutFeatureSkills.message: Skill store: 21 built-in skills, one click to install

aboutFeatureTranslate.message: Translate the whole page in place (refresh to revert)

aboutFeatureTasks.message: Scheduled page checks with system notifications

aboutPrivacy.message: Privacy: API keys, conversations and page content stay on this machine; page content is only sent to the model provider you configured.

aboutDonateHint.message: If this extension helps you, scan the WeChat code to buy the author a coffee.

aboutFeedbackHint.message: Suggestions, issues or custom features? Email the author:

langHint.message: Switch the interface language; takes effect immediately.
